response.answer: Статья "Attention is All you Need" (2017) представлена в Semantic Scholar как семинальная работа, введшая архитектуру Transformer. Дополнительные данные, такие как авторы, реферат или полный текст, не были извлечены, поскольку доступны только метаданные.

bullets: The seminal paper "Attention is All you Need" (2017) introduced the Transformer architecture and has received over 176,000 citations.
Multiple studies extend the original attention mechanism to specialized domains such as speech separation, video frame interpolation, and drug discovery.
Recent works (2024–2025) explore attention for efficient inference, including visual token pruning and KV cache optimization in diffusion LLMs.
Variants like Tensor Product Attention and Multi-Head Latent Attention propose architectural improvements for scalability and efficiency.
Cross-attention is shown to be critical in adapting pretrained Transformers for machine translation and other transfer learning tasks.
Attention mechanisms are being applied to diverse scientific problems, including quantum physics (e.g., chiral superconductivity).
Papers indicate a trend of using attention as a universal building block across modalities and tasks.
Several papers focus on reducing computational and memory costs in attention-based models while maintaining performance.
The attention paradigm continues to evolve with novel mechanisms targeting long-sequence modeling and model parallelization.
Citation counts vary widely, from 11 to over 176,000, reflecting the foundational impact of the original work.
